scenarios.purpose: An insertion before navigation anchors changes later UTF-8 byte offsets.
A macro definition edit invalidates downstream expansion while preserving local scope.
An included file change must invalidate its callers and source provenance.
A malformed document is compiled first, then its group is repaired; obsolete diagnostics must disappear if the clean compiler removes them.
A valid source becomes malformed and is repaired in the same process, preventing cached diagnostics from leaking across revisions.
